source.edition: FE-2025 REEFSCAPE field, SolidWorks 2022 STEP AP214 export stamped 2025-01-09T21:33:18; archive Last-Modified 2025-01-10 23:08:31 GMT. It predates the later field drawing revisions.

officialFrame: Inches in the file (millimetres once read), Y up, origin at the field centre on the carpet top, +X toward the red alliance wall, -Z toward the scoring table side the project calls field +Y.

fieldFrame.name: project field frame
fieldFrame.basis: experiments/six-wheel/mission/field-registration.json: 690.875 x 317 in field, origin at the blue-side corner, +X toward red, +Z up; field = (8774.1125 + x, 4025.9 - z, y)

fixtures.purpose: Red coral station (Red 3 corner) whose chute the robot receives CORAL from

dockFrames.basis: Layout robot frame at the receive dock (field_trials.py STATION and NOMINAL_DOCK_GAP): robot -X faces the station, +Y port, +Z up. The station's upper-panel datum plane through the registered origin (field-registration.json redStation.nativeOriginIn) sits at X = -455.5, 10 mm behind the rear bumper face, and the origin is at Y = 0.

notes: GE-25014 is the 16.50 in chute plate; GE-25007 the lower barrier, 9.525 mm proud of the upper-panel datum; GE-25008 and GE-25009 the panels below and above the 196.3 mm opening; GE-25015 the upper guard; GE-25020 and GE-25021 the human-side guides.
The display meshes leave out fasteners and parts under 150 mm; the STEP keeps them.

fixtures.purpose: Red REEF whose L1 trough the robot delivers CORAL into

dockFrames.basis: Layout robot frame at the shown delivery dock (pocket_geometry.py TROUGH and NOMINAL_STANDOFF): robot +X toward the reef, +Y port, +Z up. The midfield-facing trough lip face (field-registration.json redReef.lipOriginNativeMm, x = 3453.051) sits at X = 495.5, 50 mm ahead of the bumper face. Y = 0 is the centre of one of that face's two trough panels, 235.7 mm from the face centreline, so the other panel is the neighbouring sector toward -Y.

notes: GE-25302 are the six trough lip panels, GE-25313 the trough floors, GE-25315 the inner risers, GE-25301 the twelve branch weldments, GE-25310 the base sections.
The display meshes leave out fasteners, parts under 150 mm and base parts under 450 mm; the STEP keeps them.
